title: Input
description: Fiori input with value states and value state message.

usage.summary: Enter one line of text, a number or a formatted string.
useWhen: Let users enter a name, number, password, URL, phone number or email address in one line.
Keep a visible field label; use a placeholder only for a hint or example.
Use valueState and valueStateMessage to explain validation issues and how to resolve them.

avoidWhen.when: Enter a date, range or time, or provide a custom picker with caller-owned parsing.
Choose one predefined value: use Select for 2–12 options, ComboBox for type-ahead across 20–200 options, or ValueHelpDialog above 200 entries or for several searchable attributes.
Edit a locale-aware number with NumericInput, use StepInput for increment and decrement buttons, or use Slider for a visual scale.
Collect several values: use MultiComboBox for fewer than 200 predefined options, or MultiInput for caller-validated entries and datasets above 200.
